notes.title: Faithfall is out! (As a demo)
notes.notes:
Plans have changed, and the full game will likely be released in late 2025 or even 2026. However, what was originally planned as the full game will now serve as the [b]demo[/b].

For now, all updates will be applied to the demo!

We appreciate any feedback to help us make this a better game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445390/Faithfall_Demo/
